constraints.description: The production manifest gate charges the complete static /threads JavaScript closure at no more than 250000 gzip bytes while reporting exactly one named PGlite JavaScript exclusion, all PGlite non-JavaScript assets, and lazy Mermaid/Shiki ownership.

validation.validation_method: Production manifest build, fail-closed fixture proofs, and bundle evidence JSON

constraints.description: The supported serial Chromium fixtures commit the cold PGlite thread list within 1000ms, the 500-event trace lane within 100ms, and 2000 finalized Markdown lines within 250ms with structural assertions.

validation.validation_method: Playwright production preview and Chromium Storybook measurements

constraints.description: A fresh browser database may load only the semantically reproducible versioned schema seed with exact current migration versions, an ordered-definition digest, and zero rows in every product table; existing IndexedDB databases retain ordinary resume and migration behavior.

validation.validation_method: PGlite seed build/check command, real fresh-context browser fixture, and source inspection

constraints.description: Ordinary pull-request CI runs negative proofs, one manifest build, bundle enforcement, and serial performance budgets without changing provider, backend, realtime, C-14, submodule, .gitmodules, or staged license-deletion surfaces.

validation.validation_method: Workflow/source audit, full frontend verification, strict OpenSpec validation, and scoped status inspection

global_rules: Use the binding C-13 limits without a CI multiplier.
Measure the product render boundary rather than test-runner polling latency.
Do not touch C-14-owned removals, .gitmodules, crates/prometheus-skill-system, src/uar, or user-staged license deletions.
termination_conditions: All four blocking constraints pass deterministic validation.
Strict OpenSpec validation passes and the artifact packet contains exact evidence.
No critical finding remains after isolated adversarial review.
